unit.why: Title page, compiler's preface (הקדמה) on the value of telling wonder tales, with citations from Divrei Shlomo, Agra de-Kallah, R. Michel of Zlotchov and Noam Elimelekh, followed by the compiler's genealogy and a request to readers; it contains no narrated event.
